properties.note: located at B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (gas). TS is a puckered structure with dih(H6-O3-C2-N1) = -105.8 deg; the flat cand_b frame's -435.71 cm-1 out-of-plane mode is relaxed away on the true PES, so the 2-imaginary candidate (job 1291) became a 1-imaginary saddle (job 1296). Reproduced identically under declaration_0004 (job 1299 E = -169.641371451 at L4366; job 1300 frequency -1923.6069 at L614). Workflow verdict = candidate_only, solely because the 10+10-step IRC outer frames do not reach the product minimum (C2-O3 1.82 vs 4.21 A), i.e. an IRC-interval bookkeeping gate, not a connection failure.
HCN...H2O contact complex, E=-169.720742486 Ha, 0 imaginary modes

barrier_denominator.species: R_formamide (formamide, the reactant of this step; job 1210, 12 modes, 0 imaginary)
barrier_denominator.why: step start; formamide has a single amide minimum at this level, so this is also its lowest verified minimum

barrier_denominator.species: INT1a (formimidic acid conformer A, the lowest conformer of this intermediate; job 1196, re-checked 1215, 12 modes, 0 imaginary)
barrier_denominator.why: this is already the stable intermediate of the species, so the 22.80 value complies with the stable-intermediate rule without change

barrier_denominator.species: INT1b (formimidic acid conformer B, the starting node of this conformational edge; job 1187, re-checked 1200, 12 modes, 0 imaginary)
barrier_denominator.why: for a conformational edge both endpoints ARE minima of the same species, so the edge is quoted node-to-node from its own starting minimum INT1b; referencing it to INT1a instead would double-count the separate e2 barrier

edges.note: barrier = E(TS3) - E(INT1b) = -169.733877738 - (-169.745424733) = +0.011546995 Ha = 7.25 kcal/mol. If the same number were taken against INT1a (the lowest conformer of this species) it would be 10.80 kcal/mol; that variant is recorded in barrier_if_referenced_to_INT1a_kcal_mol and is NOT used, because the step starts at INT1b.

barrier_denominator.species: INT1a (formimidic acid conformer A, the stable intermediate; job 1196, E = -169.751090026 Ha, 12 modes, 0 imaginary)
barrier_denominator.why: per the batch rule the denominator of a step is the lowest verified conformer of the intermediate, NOT the higher conformer the TS happened to be connected to. INT1c is 3.92 kcal/mol above INT1a, so the barrier referenced to the stable intermediate is 68.85 instead of 64.93

edges.barrier_conformer_specific_denominator: INT1c (job 1125 E = -169.744844814; endpoint re-opt job 1302 E = -169.744844755), the conformer whose IRC connects to TS4; kept as a conformer-specific value, not deleted
edges.barrier_reference: INT1c (job 1125, E = -169.744844814 Ha) = the conformer-specific denominator; the primary barrier uses INT1a (see barrier_denominator). Pure electronic energies, no ZPE
edges.channel: 1,3-H transfer to O (N1-H4 breaks, O3-H4 forms) coupled with C2-O3 cleavage
